title: S023 — Unfounded-set non-empty / candidate sufficiency
description: Exercise the actual unfounded-set rejection path (|U| > 0) with synthetic cycles and determine whether every Phase-B consequence lies inside the changed NEITHER/candidate frontier dC.
result_summary: HOLD (with a strong positive core). Built synthetic REQUIRES-cycle canons to exercise |U| > 0: A 2-cycle |C|=2 |U|=2; B 3-cycle |C|=3 |U|=3; C/F SCCs+bridge |C|=5 |U|=5; D support gain dC=1 dU=0; E support loss dC=2 dU=2; F+ force ground dC=2 dU=2. FINDINGS: U is a subset of C in every witness; dU <= dC in every transition; the cross-SCC cascade showed U-flips outside dC = 0; behaviour follows only from the CURRENT candidate set (no prior-U or SCC state needed). observeUnfoundedSet wraps the authoritative positiveFixpoint/unfoundedSet; no reimplementation. ANSWER: an incremental Phase-A engine must hand Phase B dC (the changed NEITHER/candidate set). Phase B = Global algorithm over a local candidate domain (class B). HOLD because the corpus is 6 minimal witnesses (no randomized stress), the OR-group external-support case was mis-constructed, and determinism/branch isolation were not tested.

answers.Q1_candidate_set: the Phase-A NEITHER set (before Phase B rejects)
answers.Q2_candidate_change: when Phase A changes the NEITHER set
answers.Q4_dU_local: yes, and bounded by dC (dU <= dC)
answers.Q5_why_global: global by algorithm, local by domain - C is small
answers.Q6_scc_sufficient: yes - dC sufficed to predict every unfounded change observed
answers.Q7_support_triggers_phase_b: yes - a support change alters C without topology change
answers.Q8_external_support_local: yes - gain/loss localised to the affected candidates
answers.Q11_global_barrier_ok: yes - Phase B can remain a global barrier over a locally-supplied dC

architectural_classification: B - Global algorithm over a local candidate domain. Recommended: incremental Phase A + authoritative global Phase B, with Phase A handing Phase B the dC frontier.
limitations: Six minimal witnesses; no randomized SCC stress (5-20 nodes, 20-100 topologies).

The SCC-2 external-support construction in canon C/F did not create a genuine OR group (the external edge was ANDed into the cycle group), so 'partially externally supported SCC' was not correctly exercised.
No long-horizon runs, no determinism/branch-isolation checks.
